source_text: Similar tensions surfaced in Iceland in February 2018, when members of the Progressive Party proposed amending the Penal Code to ban non-therapeutic male circumcision on minors under 15, punishable by up to six years imprisonment, framing it as a violation of bodily autonomy akin to female genital mutilation.
